cards.audioText: Under what circumstances should a pilot use an oxygen mask in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中，飞行员应在什么情况下使用氧气面罩？
cards.referenceText: A pilot should use an oxygen mask whenever the applicable procedure requires supplemental or protective oxygen. Examples include a loss of cabin pressure, smoke or fumes, and a situation in which one pilot leaves the assigned duty station or flight deck at an altitude covered by the applicable rule. The crew should put on the mask promptly, establish communication and follow the aircraft checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 只要适用程序要求使用补充氧气或防护氧气，飞行员就应佩戴氧气面罩。例如座舱失压、出现烟雾或烟气，或者在适用规则所涵盖的高度上，一名飞行员离开指定值勤位置或驾驶舱。机组应迅速戴好面罩、建立通信并执行飞机检查单。

cards.audioText: How would you describe the oxygen system on the aircraft you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你会如何描述你所飞飞机的氧气系统？
cards.referenceText: A suitable example would be: my aircraft has separate flight-crew and passenger oxygen provisions. The pilots have quick-donning masks supplied by the aircraft system, while passenger masks deploy from overhead units when the system is activated. The exact operating logic, duration and controls are aircraft-specific and should be described from the relevant manual.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的示范答案是：我的飞机分别为飞行机组和旅客配备供氧装置。飞行员使用由飞机系统供氧的快速佩戴面罩，旅客面罩则在系统启动时从头顶装置放下。具体工作逻辑、供氧时间和控制方式因机型而异，应依据相关手册说明。

cards.audioText: When are oxygen masks automatically deployed during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中，氧气面罩会在什么情况下自动释放？
cards.referenceText: On many pressurized passenger aircraft, passenger oxygen masks deploy automatically when cabin altitude reaches the system's preset threshold. The crew may also be able to deploy them manually if needed. The exact threshold and deployment logic are aircraft-specific, so pilots must follow the aircraft manual and checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许多增压客机在座舱高度达到系统预设阈值时，会自动放下旅客氧气面罩。必要时，机组也可以手动释放面罩。具体阈值和释放逻辑因机型而异，因此飞行员必须遵循飞机手册和检查单。
